_readme: This is the contract between the agents and jarvis.html.
Copy this file to data/jarvis-data.json and the dashboard will load it on
boot, replacing the mock values section by section. Sections you leave OUT
stay on mock data and stay flagged MOCK in the header pill. That is the
point: you go live field by field, and the screen always tells you which
Every metric is an object: { v, source, asOf }.
v      - the number or string. null means UNAVAILABLE.
source - where the figure came from, in plain language.
asOf   - ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the figure was true.
Rules the Scout must not break when writing this file:
- Never write a v you did not read from a source. Write null instead.
- Never carry forward yesterday's number under today's asOf.
- A projection is labelled in its own source string, never mixed in.
Keys the loader will read: meta, objective, revenue, book, pipeline,
operator, advisor, proximity. Anything else in this file is ignored.

meta.objective: CONVERT THE ECHELON PROPOSAL AND CLEAR EVERY BLOCKED CLIENT ITEM

target.source: PLACEHOLDER: set your real monthly target

current.source: vault pipeline notes — deal fields only

status.source: derived from progress vs. days remaining

collectedMTD.source: vault pipeline notes — deal fields only

yesterday.source: NOT WIRED — needs a payment processor connector

lastMonth.source: NOT WIRED — needs a payment processor connector

attention.source: vault: status blocked, or active and untouched 7d+

nextActions.source: vault: notes carrying a next_action field

resolved.source: NOT WIRED — Operator writes this after each run

drafted.source: NOT WIRED — Operator writes this after each run

escalated.source: NOT WIRED — Operator writes this after each run

published.source: NOT WIRED — Operator writes this after each run

recommendations.action: One sentence, something you can start today.
recommendations.evidence: The specific figure or note from today's Scout run that led to it.
recommendations.cost: What it costs you if this sits untouched for a week.

unactioned: Anything recommended in the last 7 days that has not been acted on.
